cells.quote: In total, we identified 242 published reviews (Table 1), including systematic reviews as well as a small number of meta-analyses, scoping reviews, narrative reviews, and umbrella reviews. The number of these studies has increased steadily over time (Fig. 1), and the earliest identified publication was in 2015.
cells.note: The study reports a descriptive publication trend rather than an instructional treatment comparison; the contrast is coded as later versus earlier publication years.
